text: きみは　いつでも　ボタンひとつで　おにいさんに　あえて　しまう！

structure.en: get to meet, just like that!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing just goes and happens; here it is a playful 'just like that', not regret. あえて　しまう = 'you end up able to meet me'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing あう to あえる turns 'meet' into 'can meet'; あえて is its て form. おにいさんに　あえて = 'being able to meet big bro'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what you use to get something done. ボタンひとつで = 'with a single button'.
